meaning.zh:
“刚刚” 或 “刚才”。

这个短语用于描述刚发生的事情，通常在几分钟或几秒钟内。它用来表示某个事件离现在非常近，时间上刚刚过去，没有什么时间的间隔。
meaning.en: This phrase is used to refer to something that happened a moment ago, usually within the last few minutes or seconds. It is used to denote that an event is very close to the present time, having just occurred without much time elapsed.

lines.en: I saw him *just now* at the store.
lines.zh: 我刚刚在商店里看见了他。

lines.en: She called me *just now* to inform me of the meeting.
lines.zh: 她刚才给我打电话通知我开会。

lines.en: We received the email *just now* and are reviewing it.
lines.zh: 我们刚刚收到邮件，正在审核。
